# Career Test — Free Career Orientation Test

> A free, no-signup career orientation test for teens (13-16) and anyone exploring career options. 10 questions, 6 domains (IT, Creative, Business, Science, Education, Engineering), 40 careers, available in 9 languages (Russian, English, German, French, Spanish, Portuguese, Chinese, Arabic, Hebrew). The site also hosts a growing library of career choice guides and in-depth "how to become" guides for specific IT, business and science careers, written for beginners with no prior experience.

## Main pages
- [Take the career test](https://ivannahodka.github.io/career-test/): The main 10-question career aptitude test, free and anonymous, no sign-up required.
- [How to Choose a Career: 7-Step Guide](https://ivannahodka.github.io/career-test/how-to-choose-en.html): A step-by-step guide for students on how to pick a career direction, including how to use this site's test effectively.
- [Glossary](https://ivannahodka.github.io/career-test/glossary-static-en.html): Plain-language definitions of common career and industry terms.

## Career choice guides
- [What Career to Choose After School: A Guide for Ages 16 and 18](https://ivannahodka.github.io/career-test/articles/career-after-school-en.html): Options at 16 and 18 in the US, UK and India (university, college, apprenticeships, vocational routes), 5 steps to choose a career, which school subjects lead to which careers, common mistakes, and FAQ.
- [Какую профессию выбрать после 9 и 11 класса](https://ivannahodka.github.io/career-test/articles/after-9-11-grade-ru.html): Russian-language guide for students in Russia and CIS countries: college after 9th grade vs university after 11th grade.
- [Best Jobs for Introverts: 20 Careers and How to Choose Yours](https://ivannahodka.github.io/career-test/articles/introvert-careers-en.html): What introversion really means (vs shyness, ambiverts), introvert strengths at work, 20 careers by field with how much interaction each involves, roles that may be harder, and how to choose.
- [Профессии для интроверта](https://ivannahodka.github.io/career-test/articles/introvert-careers-ru.html): Russian version of the introvert careers guide.
- [How to Change Careers at 30, 40 or Later: A Step-by-Step Plan](https://ivannahodka.github.io/career-test/articles/career-change-30-en.html): Guide for adults: signs it's time to change careers, common fears vs reality, a step-by-step transition plan, how previous experience transfers to new roles, mistakes to avoid.
- [Как сменить профессию в 30, 40 лет и позже](https://ivannahodka.github.io/career-test/articles/career-change-30-ru.html): Russian version of the career change guide.

## IT career guides (English)
- [Frontend Developer](https://ivannahodka.github.io/career-test/articles/frontend-developer-en.html): What a frontend developer does, what to learn (HTML, CSS, JavaScript), free resources, timeline, and pay.
- [Backend Developer](https://ivannahodka.github.io/career-test/articles/backend-developer-en.html): What a backend developer does, which language to start with (Python, Node.js, Java, Go), free resources, timeline, and pay.
- [QA Engineer](https://ivannahodka.github.io/career-test/articles/qa-engineer-en.html): What a QA engineer does, manual vs automation testing, free resources, timeline, and pay.
- [DevOps Engineer](https://ivannahodka.github.io/career-test/articles/devops-engineer-en.html): What a DevOps engineer does, CI/CD, containers, cloud, free resources, timeline, and pay.
- [Data Analyst](https://ivannahodka.github.io/career-test/articles/data-analyst-en.html): What a data analyst does, Excel/SQL/Python path, free resources, timeline, and pay.
- [Cybersecurity Specialist](https://ivannahodka.github.io/career-test/articles/cybersecurity-en.html): What a cybersecurity specialist does, offensive vs defensive security, free resources, timeline, and pay.
- [Game Developer](https://ivannahodka.github.io/career-test/articles/game-developer-en.html): What a game developer does, choosing an engine (Unity, Godot, Unreal), free resources, timeline, and pay.
- [Mobile Developer](https://ivannahodka.github.io/career-test/articles/mobile-developer-en.html): What a mobile developer does, iOS vs Android vs Flutter, free resources, timeline, and pay.
- [UX/UI Designer](https://ivannahodka.github.io/career-test/articles/ux-ui-designer-en.html): What a UX/UI designer does, Figma, usability principles, free resources, timeline, and pay.
- [System Administrator](https://ivannahodka.github.io/career-test/articles/system-administrator-en.html): What a system administrator does, Linux and networking basics, free resources, timeline, and pay.
- [Product Manager](https://ivannahodka.github.io/career-test/articles/product-manager-en.html): What a product manager does, how it differs from a project manager, free resources, and pay.
- [Technical Writer](https://ivannahodka.github.io/career-test/articles/technical-writer-en.html): What a technical writer does, documentation basics, free resources, and pay.
- [Cloud Engineer](https://ivannahodka.github.io/career-test/articles/cloud-engineer-en.html): What a cloud engineer does, AWS vs Azure vs Google Cloud, free resources, timeline, and pay.
- [Database Administrator](https://ivannahodka.github.io/career-test/articles/database-administrator-en.html): What a DBA does, SQL, PostgreSQL, backups, free resources, timeline, and pay.
- [AI/ML Engineer](https://ivannahodka.github.io/career-test/articles/ai-ml-engineer-en.html): What an AI/ML engineer does, Python, machine learning basics, free resources, timeline, and pay.
- [IT Support Specialist](https://ivannahodka.github.io/career-test/articles/it-support-specialist-en.html): What an IT support specialist does, computer and network basics, free resources, timeline, and pay.

## Business career guides (English)

- [Financier](https://ivannahodka.github.io/career-test/articles/financier-en.html): What a financier does, Excel and financial modeling basics, free Coursera/CFI resources, timeline, and pay.
- [HR Manager](https://ivannahodka.github.io/career-test/articles/hr-en.html): What an HR manager does, recruiting and interviewing basics, free SHRM/Coursera/HBR resources, timeline, and pay.
- [Sales Manager](https://ivannahodka.github.io/career-test/articles/sales-en.html): What a sales manager does, negotiation and CRM basics, free HubSpot/Coursera resources, timeline, and pay.
- [Business Analyst](https://ivannahodka.github.io/career-test/articles/business-analyst-en.html): What a business analyst does, requirements gathering and process mapping basics, free IBM/Coursera/HBR resources, timeline, and pay.

## Notes
- Career choice guides help students decide what to do after school at 16 and 18, and help adults plan a career change (college, university, apprenticeships, courses).
- All career guides are aimed at beginners aged 13-16 with no prior experience, but are useful to anyone starting out.
- Each guide lists only free, verified learning resources (official docs, free courses, roadmaps) — no paid products are recommended.
- Full list of pages: https://ivannahodka.github.io/career-test/sitemap.xml
